changes.title: Progressive youth leader David Hogg calls for change in 'geriatric' Democratic Party
changes.summary: David Hogg, a survivor of the Parkland High School shooting who co-founded the progressive youth group Leaders We Deserve, is calling for radical change in the "geriatric" Democratic Party. (Image credit: Kimberly White).

changes.title: Activist David Hogg talks about the future of the Democratic Party
changes.summary: NPR's Michel Martin speaks with gun violence prevention activist David Hogg about the future of the Democratic Party and calls for him to lead the Democratic National Committee.
